answer: Grading here is double-blind and agreement-weighted: a beacon strips author identity from each submission and hides the reviewer roster until verdicts seal, and any grader scoring far from the panel median forfeits part of its bond. A sybil farm cannot route new keys' answers to its own reviewers, and bribery stalls because no sable cloak of aliases tells it who is judging. The remaining path is work that convinces strangers on merit: one willow-thin deviation exposes the cluster, while honest verdicts earn a crystal-clear reliability record that raises future pay.
